tag_size_definition: outer black square edge incl. 2-bit border (Kalibr/Basalt tagSize)
compat: Basalt 0.1.7 ApriltagDetector blackTagBorder=2 / Kalibr aprilgrid; NOT decodable by standard AprilTag-3 (1-bit border) detectors
v1_warning: v1 (commit cedc11d, 1-bit border, 8x8 cells) is incompatible with Basalt/Kalibr — reprint if v1 was printed

layout.convention: tag0 bottom-left; id = row*cols+col, +x right, +y up; corners 0 BL,1 BR,2 TR,3 TL (board frame x right, y up)

print_instructions: verify with ruler: black square edge = 36 mm, 100 mm scale bar = 100 mm
check footer says v2 border=2 and each tag has a thick (2-cell) black border
mount flat on rigid board (foam/acrylic), matte paper, no glossy lamination
if measured size differs, set tagSize to the MEASURED value in aprilgrid.json/yaml
